text: Mr. Beebe watched them, and watched the seeds of the willow-herb dance chorically above their heads. “Apooshoo, apooshoo, apooshoo,” went Freddy, swimming for two strokes in either direction, and then becoming involved in reeds or mud. “Is it worth it?” asked the other, Michelangelesque on the flooded margin. The bank broke away, and he fell into the pool before he had weighed the question properly. “Hee-poof—I’ve swallowed a pollywog, Mr. Beebe, water’s wonderful, water’s simply ripping.” “Water’s not so bad,” said George, reappearing from his plunge, and sputtering at the sun.
